Description: Research, user journeys, wireframes and system flow for FinSight.
Coordinate model, context, permissions and the analysis workflow.
Market data tools, technical and fundamental analysis, comparisons and projections.
API, UI, sandbox, background processing and deployment.
CI, documentation, board hygiene, slides and demo.
Map the journey of an investor asking questions in chat. Acceptance criteria: 1) At least 2 personas or scenarios. 2) Steps, pain points and opportunities shown. 3) Board link added to the README.
Low-fidelity screens for chat, candlestick chart and comparison table. Acceptance criteria: 1) 3 screens drawn. 2) Sources and assumptions area visible. 3) Matches the web UI layout.
Flow from user question to tool calls to answer, including the queue path. Acceptance criteria: 1) Shows sync and background paths. 2) Shows sandbox step. 3) Consistent with the architecture diagram.

Diagram of services, integrations, data flow, workers, queue and sandbox. Acceptance criteria: 1) Shows EC2, Redis, Celery worker, sandbox, Claude API, market data. 2) Arrows show data flow. 3) Exported to docs/.

Implement the harness loop that calls Claude, runs requested tools and returns the final answer. Acceptance criteria: 1) Multi-step tool use works. 2) Max step limit enforced. 3) Tool trace returned with the answer.

Allow-list of tools, system prompt rules, error handling for tool failures. Acceptance criteria: 1) Unknown tools are rejected. 2) Tool errors do not crash the loop. 3) Prompt forbids invented figures.

Summary: Sources and assumptions in every answer
Description: Each answer ends with Sources and Assumptions. Acceptance criteria: 1) Tools return a source field. 2) Answers include both sections. 3) Disclaimer shown in the UI.
Tool that returns daily OHLCV history for a ticker. Acceptance criteria: 1) Works for periods 1mo to 5y. 2) Invalid ticker returns a clear error. 3) Source included in output.
Indicators computed with pandas. Acceptance criteria: 1) Unit tests pass. 2) Latest values returned by a tool. 3) Parameters documented as assumptions.
Valuation ratios, income statement and earnings. Acceptance criteria: 1) P/E, market cap, margins returned. 2) Latest income statement returned. 3) Missing data handled.
Compare return and volatility of several tickers; projection and what-if via the sandbox. Acceptance criteria: 1) Up to 5 tickers compared. 2) A DCA what-if example works. 3) Assumptions stated.
Plotly candlestick chart and tables in the UI. Acceptance criteria: 1) Candlestick renders from price tool output. 2) Chart is interactive. 3) Tables for comparisons.
Isolated code execution service. Acceptance criteria: 1) No internet access. 2) Timeout, memory and process limits. 3) Tests for success and timeout.

Summary: Celery and Redis: long jobs, progress, retries
Description: Background analysis with task queue. Acceptance criteria: 1) POST /jobs returns a job id. 2) GET /jobs/id shows progress and result. 3) Retries with backoff.

Separate backend and frontend folders connected through an nginx /api proxy. API and chat interface. Acceptance criteria: 1) /chat, /jobs, /health work. 2) Chat UI shows charts and tool trace. 3) Swagger docs available.
Deploy the full stack on a new EC2 instance. Acceptance criteria: 1) docker compose up works on EC2. 2) UI and API reachable on public IP. 3) Secrets only in .env on the server.
Lint and test on every pull request. Acceptance criteria: 1) ruff and pytest run in CI. 2) Failing checks block merge. 3) Badge or link in README.
Project README, CONTRIBUTING and PR template. Acceptance criteria: 1) Quick start works from scratch. 2) Contributions per member documented. 3) Branch and PR rules written.

Summary: Jira board cleanup and acceptance criteria
Description: Keep statuses current and tickets linked to PRs. Acceptance criteria: 1) Every story has acceptance criteria. 2) Statuses reflect reality. 3) GitHub links visible on tickets.
Brief deck: problem, features, architecture, demo. Acceptance criteria: 1) 5 to 6 slides. 2) Architecture diagram included. 3) Demo steps written.
Run the live demo end to end twice. Acceptance criteria: 1) Quick question, comparison and background job shown. 2) Backup screenshots ready. 3) Both members can explain every part.
